title: AGIBOT 在 2026 年 AGIBOT 创新日上推出 Worken 来测量机器人生产力
summary: AGIBOT unveiled its AHA3 integrated platform, GO-3 Preview, and WITA-Omni 1.0 model, as well as the G2 Max robot and Link-U OS 1.0 framework. The post AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 appeared first on The Robot Report .（原题：AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026）
